verdict.rationale: Angular is an open-source web framework and CLI that runs in the developer's own environment. It does not host or ingest user content, so an opt-out from AI model training is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Angular operating a data-collecting service whose data could be used for training; the 'AI-forward resources' and llms.txt items concern helping AI tools consume Angular's docs, not user data.
